name: Evi
title: Midianite king
summary: Evi was one of five Midianite kings who were killed by the Israelites in the war against Midian, on the Lord's command through Moses. He is mentioned together with the kings Rekem, Sur, Hur and Reba. These kings were vassals under the Amorite king Sihon, and their defeat was part of Israel's conquest of the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The War Against Midian
keyEvents.description: The Lord commanded Moses to wage war against the Midianites as punishment for leading Israel into idolatry at Peor. An army of 12,000 Israelites was sent out under the leadership of Phinehas.

keyEvents.title: Evi's Death in Battle
keyEvents.description: Evi was killed together with the four other Midianite kings, Rekem, Sur, Hur, and Reba, during Israel's campaign against Midian.

keyEvents.title: Balaam's Death in the Same Battle
keyEvents.description: In addition to the five kings, the prophet Balaam son of Beor was also killed by the sword in that same battle, because he had given advice on how to lead Israel astray.

keyEvents.title: Evi Mentioned as a Vassal under Sihon
keyEvents.description: In the book of Joshua, Evi is mentioned as one of the Midianite chieftains who were vassals under the Amorite king Sihon and lived in the land.

keyEvents.title: The Distribution of the Conquered Land
keyEvents.description: After the victory over the Midianites and their kings, including Evi, their land was allotted to the tribe of Reuben as part of the land distribution east of the Jordan.
